# MARK Technologies (mark2.in) — Full Technical Specification & Knowledge Base

> Organization: MARK Technologies
> Domain: https://www.mark2.in
> Primary Email: hello@mark2.in
> Focus: Product Engineering, Full-Stack Web Development, Enterprise ERP Systems, Cloud Architecture, AI Automation.

---

## 1. Company Profile
MARK Technologies is a specialized software engineering consultancy and product agency based in India, delivering bespoke software solutions to high-growth businesses, venture-backed startups, and enterprise clients worldwide. 

### Key Capabilities:
- Full-Stack Web Applications (Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript)
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems (Modular architectures, multi-tenant databases, role-based access control)
- Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications (React Native, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin)
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Automation (LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Agentic workflows)
- Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Cloud Infrastructure, Database Replication, Containerization, and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

---

## 2. Engineering Standards & Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router, React Server Components), React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Next.js Server Actions & Route Handlers, Python (FastAPI/LangChain for AI pipelines).
- **Databases**: MongoDB (Mongoose), PostgreSQL, Redis (caching and rate limiting).
- **Authentication & Security**: Jose JWT, HTTP-only secure cookie sessions, Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), Content Security Policy (CSP), rate-limiting middleware.
- **Media & Assets**: Cloudinary CDN, next/image with AVIF/WebP next-gen compression.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Vercel Edge Network, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront), Docker.

---

## 3. Detailed Service Catalog

### 3.1 Website & Web Application Development
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/services/website-development
- **Scope**: Enterprise-grade marketing sites, SaaS dashboards, customer portals, and internal business tools.
- **Features**: Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), Schema.org JSON-LD microdata, dynamic OpenGraph generation.

### 3.2 Custom ERP Development
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/services/custom-erp-development
- **Scope**: Tailor-made business operating systems that eliminate third-party SaaS license sprawl.
- **Key Modules**: Inventory ledger, Bill of Materials (BOM), Multi-branch accounting, Purchase orders, Automated invoice generation, Staff attendance & payroll, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

### 3.3 Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & AI Discoverability (AEO)
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/services/search-engine-optimization
- **Scope**: Auditing and engineering sites to rank in conventional Google search and appear verbatim in AI Overviews, Perplexity citations, and ChatGPT web browsing passes.
- **Features**: Semantic HTML5 hierarchy, FAQPage schema, BreadcrumbList, Organization graph, llms.txt endpoints, Core Web Vitals < 2.5s LCP.

### 3.4 AI Automation & Intelligent Agents
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/services
- **Scope**: Custom AI workflows connecting internal data stores to large language models.
- **Features**: Document QA over proprietary PDFs, autonomous data synchronization bots, conversational customer support assistants with tool execution.

## 4. Proprietary Enterprise Platforms

### 4.1 EduVeera School Management ERP
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/products/eduveera-school-management-erp
- **Description**: 16-module academic ERP designed for single-campus schools and multi-branch educational trusts.
- **Highlights**: Manages 10,000+ active students, automated fee receipts via WhatsApp and SMS, real-time bus GPS tracking, examination report cards.

### 4.2 Omni-Channel eCommerce Engine
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/products/omni-channel-ecommerce-engine
- **Description**: Distributed headless commerce platform handling high concurrency flash sales with sub-100ms API response times.
- **Highlights**: Unified stock ledger across retail stores, website, and marketplaces; integrated payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay); automated courier dispatch.

### 4.3 Keshera Manufacturing ERP
- **URL**: https://www.mark2.in/products/keshera-manufacturing-erp
- **Description**: Shop-floor management platform for precision component manufacturers.
- **Highlights**: Manages ₹15Cr+ inventory across multi-stage production lines, CNC machine uptime tracking, ISO 9001 compliance logs.

## 5. Pricing & Engagement Models (INR)

- **Starter Website Package**: ₹25,000. Up to 5 pages. Best for boutique agencies, professional services, and high-converting marketing landers. Delivery: 7-10 days.
- **Growth Web Application**: ₹75,000. Full-stack custom portal or SaaS prototype with authentication and database integration. Delivery: 3-4 weeks.
- **Enterprise Retainer**: ₹1,50,000+ / month or fixed-quote. Dedicated engineering squad for multi-month ERP and mobile app builds. SLA guarantees.

URL: https://www.mark2.in/pricing
